CLINICAL FEATURES OF VITAMIN K DEFICIENCY BLEEDING
Clinical Presentation
- Classical type presents between the second and fourth days of life.
- Early type presents within the first 24 hours of life while the late type occurs as late as three to six weeks of life.
- Classical features include oozing from puncture sites or circumcision sites, umbilical stump haemorrhage, haematemesis and or melaena, ecchymoses, epistaxis or scalp haemorrhage, intra-viscera haemorrhage (kidney, brain) may also occur in severe cases.
